name: the header paints the column's name, not its label
why: Without the label the feature does nothing visible; every key-based check would still pass.

name: the labelled flex does not carry the column's name
why: A saved file keeps the header's innerHTML, not the th's data-col-name; without the flex key a reloaded header reads "Work" and the pair is injected a second time.

name: the disk restore rebuilds a labelled header from its label text
why: The restore collapses a decorated header to its text node, which is the label: the header then becomes a column named "Work".

name: the tooltip gets the column's name again on every decoration
why: makeTableSortableUnified() re-runs on the same header; without the guard the tooltip grows one name line per pass.

name: isColVisible matches header text again
why: The labelled pair reads "Work"/"Perf.", so hiding the other collapsable columns hides the collapse button although the pair is still visible.

name: the Statistics panel reads the header text
why: The panel would list the columns as "Work" and "Perf.".

name: a filter error names the column by its header text
why: The invalid-regexp message would say Column "Work".

name: sa_short_column_labels is ignored
why: With the setting off the headers must paint their names.

name: features.columnLabels is ignored
why: A pageType's own labels must merge over the built-in ones.

name: _cleanColHeaderText() reads a labelled flex's text node
why: Belt and braces: every decorated header has data-col-name, which step 1 returns first, so no spec reaches step 2 with a labelled flex. Recorded so the guard is not mistaken for tested.

name: makeTableSortableUnified() takes a labelled header's name from its text
why: Belt and braces: the restore already writes the name as the header's text, and a re-decorated header still has data-col-name, so no spec reaches this fallback.
